name: 0000-MAIN
description: This paragraph orchestrates the execution of the main tasks in a batch accounts-receivable program by performing file setup, transaction processing, and cleanup sequentially.

Output information to the console or log for tracking or debugging.
End the program execution and return control to the operating system.
